policy: Entries are based on inspected feature-branch source. This inventory is not proof of runtime behavior or a complete binary-asset scan.

items.description: The original primitive blockout has been upgraded in source with procedural curved multi-tier roofs, articulated columns and beams, a layered Main Hall, stone path slabs, deterministic PBR-like noise/bump textures, procedural trees, wind sway, grass patches, moss-topped rocks and distant mountain meshes. This remains asset-independent placeholder art, not final Blender-authored hero geometry.
items.replacement: Approved Blender-authored hero architecture, Buddha statue, high-quality trees and environment assets with optimized collision proxies; retain procedural fallback until each replacement passes QA.
items.acceptance: Run typecheck, unit tests, build and browser QA; verify silhouettes, UV/material response, shadows, vegetation motion, mobile performance and all preserved world anchors/collisions before calling this art-ready.

items.description: PlaceholderAvatar is used when VITE_PLAYER_MODEL_URL is not configured.
items.replacement: Production player GLB with validated skeleton, animation clips, scale and retargeting contract.
items.acceptance: Load and test on desktop and touch devices; verify animation aliases, bounds, collider alignment and missing-model fallback.

items.description: Manifest references /assets/navmesh/temple_complex.json; exact file was absent in the inspected feature branch.
items.replacement: Blender-authored and validated navmesh JSON matching walkable geometry and region coordinates.
items.acceptance: Pass tools/validate-navmesh.mjs and topology tests; verify bounds, connectivity and collision correspondence before enabling pathfinding.
